purpose: Close electronic catalogue admission with reduced one/two-cell use tests; assess an explicitly authorized derived NbN phonon table independently. This is not production promotion or completion of all D.4 item 2 dynamics.

error_convention.relative: abs(value-reference)/abs(reference), only for a nonzero well-conditioned reference; always retain absolute error and denominator
error_convention.roundoff_floor: Convergence ratios are required only when the compared error exceeds 100 machine epsilons times the declared scale. Otherwise report roundoff limited, retaining all errors.
error_convention.no_clipping: Do not repair populations, energy, forces or fluxes. Explicit material-data clipping is a different, authorized preprocessing operation and must remain traceable.

electronic.scope: Synthetic dimensionless time, positive-amplitude sampled R2 domain, isolated external boundaries. No NbN kinetic time calibration.
provenance: R2 catalogue and query source hashes unchanged
Scenario parameters, numerical settings and source hashes recorded
Production solver and historical R2 artefacts unchanged

required: Energy inversion on the actual catalogue weights and energies
Constant positive tau over energy
Compare fixed-field trajectory with the exact convex relaxation
At least two nonthermal populations, vacuum and thermal stationarity
Entropy nondecreasing for fixed spectrum and energy
Reject energy outside finite FD range
Actual R2 E(x), amplitude and Gamma derivatives
Prescribed moving amplitude and Gamma with independently accumulated field-work ledger
Source D.18 from vacuum with positive bath temperature
Thermal source direction check
No second spectral drift at fixed state count
Reject positive heating when no electronic capacity remains
A negative control omitting field work must visibly fail
Evolve amplitude_dot=-M*X_amplitude at fixed Gamma=0 using the same catalogue energy and force
M positive constant synthetic mobility, not a material KWT identification
Deposit Q=M*X_amplitude^2 exactly once through D.18
Retain full populations and energy-conserving BGK
Compare at least three time resolutions
No external heating or work in the closed energy balance
Unequal superconducting spectra from the actual R2 catalogue
One shared energy coordinate and one antisymmetric interface flux
D_L=N1^2-R2^2 from the causal spectrum; explicit positive interface rule and support handling
Same represented f(E) gives zero flux despite unequal p(x)
Shared interpolated FD equilibrium and convergence to physical FD distinguished
Energy transfer hot to cold for a declared thermal case
Pauli without clipping
Remapping and quasiparticle-count defect quantified independently
Time refinement distinct from shared-energy refinement
two_cell_transport.permitted_discretization: Energy-lumped capacities H_j/E_j with H_j=sum_i w_i E_i hat_j(E_i), explicitly a consistency-tested energy-conservative transport prototype. This is not exact discrete quasiparticle-number conservation or complete spatial D.17 implementation.
two_cell_transport.energy_refinement_requirement: Last-grid remap and count defects pass and decrease as the grid is refined; retain all grids. Further genuine refinement is permitted without changing tolerances.

failure_tests: No fabricated tail or silently discarded flux
next_stage_limits: These tests do not complete simultaneous self-consistent two-cell condensate plus electron-phonon kinetics
No phonon positivity claim without evolved phonon populations
No spatial principal-symbol, core, interface-reservoir or circuit validation
No full transient or material latency prediction
No uniform-in-domain accuracy claim beyond the actual samples

material.authorization: Explicit derived-data clipping is permitted for this assessment; do not reject it merely because it differs from the raw data.
provenance_required: Exact public source revision and local/raw hashes
Evidence for units and normalization distinguished from a local added header
All derived transformations and removed support recorded
No normalization inferred solely by forcing an integral to a desired count
proposed_derived_rule: First ordinate for repeated abscissa, if supported by the source solver unique stable policy
Set negative phonon DOS to zero
Set alpha2F to zero only where derived DOS is zero to enforce common support

also: Tail-localized populations retained even if thermally negligible

observables: Normal energy-exchange proxy with Te=10,40,160,600 K and Tph=4 K
alpha2F/DOS kernel and its behavior at support edges
Energy fraction retained in the B.39 phonon injection
Removed alpha2F area and first removed support energy
material.degenerate_observable_policy: Keep absolute changes and denominator; a zero or negative reference does not establish negligible relative impact or a physical kernel.
material.conditional_shape_admission: May admit an explicitly restricted derived shape only with reported support and sensitivity limits. A failed tail-profile or singular-kernel check cannot be hidden by small low-temperature bulk changes.
material.absolute_material_admission: Requires primary evidence of energy units, DOS basis, volume/atomic normalization and rate convention. If unresolved, SI phonon/rate prediction remains blocked regardless of clipping sensitivity.

execution.long_calculation_policy: Record command in /home/jdiaz/GEMINGA_COMMANDS.md and wait for user execution; no background workaround or repeated timeout splitting.

verdict_policy: Evaluate electronic and material gates separately. Freeze tolerances before results. Missing evidence is pending, not inferred passing. A final certificate binds exact input, code, criteria and results hashes and states the next permitted implementation task.
